claims.title: Quantum detector benchmarking and noncomputable sufficient reference memory

quoted_fields.interface: Detectors E=(E_i) explicitly list finite matrices with rational real/imaginary entries,E_i>0,sum_i E_i=I. Prepare faithful rho_AR,sigma_AR;evaluate BOTH detectors on the SAME hypotheses and finite retained quantum reference R. Detectors output classical labels and R remains local. C(X,Y)=-log2 min_(0<=s<=1)Tr X^s Y^(1-s),for fixed-pair independent-copy equal-prior discrimination. V_C=sup_R,rho,sigma[C(Q_Rrho,Q_Rsigma)-C(P_Rrho,P_Rsigma)]. With a_E=Tr sqrt(E_Rrho)sqrt(E_Rsigma),V_bal=sup log2(a_P/a_Q). Exact fair-bit swap pairs (rho directsum sigma)/2 and(sigma directsum rho)/2 physically realize the balanced subclass;V_bal<=V_C,not an equality claim.
quoted_fields.failure: No universal approximately sufficient reference budget is computed. Positive-witness existence does not supply its unknown state/reference or a practical experiment. V_bal is a subclass of V_C and their numerical equality is not assumed. Finite-memory algebraicity concerns2^V_bal,r;its logarithm need not be algebraic. Faithful-domain suprema need not be attained. Independent-copy/primitive implementation assumptions do not cover arbitrary correlated memory errors;one-call calibration does not certify an n-call correlated device. Relative effect tolerances are Loewner-order promises for valid normalized detectors,not generic uncontrolled hardware drift. No helper transmission channel,reference recovery,RLD-order impossibility,ordinary-capacity algorithm/hardness result or technological advantage is inferred. Accepted N675 scaled normalized output bounds remain intact;no new proof audit or source-model substitution.
